text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Meisho Doto has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm reminded suddenly of the hot spring ticket we won in that raffle.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, well… Is it… really okay if I… use it?
choice_data_list: Of course it is. Go and enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… it was such a lucky prize. Using something filled with so much joy… is actually kind of scary…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So, if you d-don't mind, um, could you come with me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I think if you're with me, I'd feel a little more… at ease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh wooow! I can't believe we made it right on time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I usually go down the wrong road, or take the wrong train line, so I'm not used to this punctuality.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And it's all because you looked up the maps and timetables for me. Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow… Is it okay for me to eat something that looks this wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Th-thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Mmm…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A charred smell comes wafting through the air. On closer inspection, it appears Meisho Doto's chopsticks have caught the flames of the dish heater.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaa!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so s-s-sorry about that! Oh, and we were having such a good trip!
choice_data_list: I'm just glad it was nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not every day you get to go to the hot springs. I suggest the both of us regain our spirits with a long bath.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're right—we're here to experience the hot springs. Getting to relax in a warm, steamy tub sounds so nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, the water was lovely.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Although, I did trip over the basin… and I lost the key to my locker.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But that didn't stop me from enjoying the springs. ♪ Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah… Um… On the news… it said there's going to be a meteor shower today!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I looked into it and found a good viewing point in the area. So, would you… like to go with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm s-sorry! I g-got us lost!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Taking a right at the big pine tree should have led us to the ocean, but… it's only more and more forest…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would be a shame to miss the meteor shower, but going too far from the inn doesn't seem safe.
choice_data_list: Should we stop and head back?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… Would it be okay for us to… stay out a little longer? Not too long, though… I promise.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can give you a piggyback ride if you get tired!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly, but respectfully, decline the piggyback offer. The two of us walk for several more hours.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: We've m-made it! Wow, what a beautiful view. And the night sky is filled with stars!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If we wait long enough, I wonder if some shooting stars will appear. I'm sorry to bother you again… but could we stay a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of us wait for the meteor shower to start.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …I'm so glad you chose to come along, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I'd be feeling really down in the dumps if you weren't here.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This is such a special occasion, and yet I burnt my chopsticks and then got lost.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …It's not just today. I felt the same way during the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If you weren't there for me, Trainer, I just know I would've spiraled.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's why I've built this habit of always calling other people amazing, to… try and return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Because without you, I couldn't have taken that first… step.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. You're amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto erupts with joy before I have the time to respond.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh! There goes a sh-shooting star! The meteor shower is here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look up to see dozens of shooting stars passing by.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This is amazing, I can't believe we're here to see it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you… happy right now?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Was I… a-able to bring you a wonderful experience?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Th-thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You know… I wanted to show my gratitude after causing so much trouble…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So that was the reason she wanted to see the meteor shower. It isn't normally like her to do prior research and be so dead fixed on something.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Then I'm… I'm happy I could make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enjoy the meteor shower together… The road back to the inn, however, isn't so easy. We lose our way yet again, and a deer chases us into a river, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Meisho Doto and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
